chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Isma'il ibn Marar from Yunus from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah from Abu Basir who said:

I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), 'A man who was performing Tamattu' then announced the Talbiyah for Hajj.' He said, 'He does not perform Tawaf around the House until he goes to Arafat. If he performs Tawaf before going to Mina without a valid excuse, that Tawaf is not counted.'

key_terms.أَهَلَّ بِالْحَجِّ: Announced the Talbiyah for Hajj / entered Ihram for Hajj
key_terms.عَرَفَاتٍ: Arafat, the essential station of Hajj
key_terms.مُتَمَتِّعاً: One performing Hajj al-Tamattu' (combining Umrah and Hajj)
key_terms.مِنًى: Mina, the tent city near Mecca

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on performing Tawaf before Arafat for a pilgrim performing Hajj al-Tamattu'?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies a specific procedural nuance for the Mu'tamir, distinguishing the Tawaf al-Qudum from the Tawaf al-Ziyarah by mandating that the former be deferred until after the standing at Arafat. This ruling underscores the Shia scholarly emphasis on the chronological integrity of Hajj rites, ensuring that the pilgrim’s initial circumambulation serves its proper preparatory function rather than prematurely concluding the Hajj obligations.
